'''Manak''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories]]. The plant grew in the desert world's cooler [[Cave/Legends|grottoes]]<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" /> and by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="PhantomDate">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> their [[Manak leaf|leaves]] were used to flavor [[Gorg/Legends|gorgs]], an [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] also native to Tatooine.<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Manak was first mentioned mentioned in the [[2001]] reference book ''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]'', published by [[Chronicle Books]] and written by [[Terryl Whitlatch]] and [[Bob Carrau]].<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>
